value: Vogl, V., Åhman, M., & Nilsson, L. J. (2018). Assessment of hydrogen direct reduction for fossil-free steelmaking. Journal of Cleaner Production, 203, 736-745. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jclepro.2018.08.279
No currency year stated. Input prices are 2015-2018 market averages; capex for 2030 technology from 2013 studies. 2018_EUR assumed from publication date - a judgement.

Model study of one plant design. Plant-level rows on shaft-furnace_hydrogen are the whole H-DR route (electrolyser + shaft + EAF) per tonne of liquid steel; the electrolyser and EAF also get component rows. The supplementary data (full assumption list) is not held. p.741 prints hydrogen cost as '3.30 EUR/t' - read as EUR/kg.
